notes: Submit solution/main.py plus README/NOTES. The required run is `python solution/main.py run --input input --output output`; `python solution/main.py doctor --input input` performs the non-executing input/dependency inspection (exit 78 if missing). The tool loads the pinned Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct from the manifest model path on CUDA in bfloat16 with greedy decoding (<=256 new tokens), extracts a single SELECT/WITH statement, statically rejects write/DDL/multi-statement SQL, executes it on a mode=ro SQLite connection with a 3 s progress-handler timeout, and archives id/sql/results-or-real-execution_error/raw/token_ids in answers.jsonl plus run.json with hashes, timings, GPU events and per-question status. `query --database PATH --question TEXT --output JSON` handles new questions against any SQLite file. No gold SQL, mock weights, CPU fallback or agent-written answers are used; model quality limitations are documented rather than claimed away.
